description: Non-capture seconds per point (goto + tracking + settle + flush + disk/persist + guards = point_total_sec - capture_sec) versus move size (max of |dRA*cos(dec)|, |dDec|), from the capture_timing_*.csv + mosaic.csv metadata of real campaigns. Capture seconds are planned separately.
source: data/mosaic/*/capture_timing_*.csv and mosaic.csv (metadata only; no IQ read)
ha_crossing: mount_slew_model.json (frozen almita-slew-4.0): an HA-sign-crossing move has central prediction 64.2 s and safe 85.5 s vs 13.1+0.322*axis s in the normal regime: the design must keep every position on ONE side of the meridian; capture.py also re-blocks points by HA sign, which would reorder an interleaved schedule.
repeat_same_coordinate: no zero-distance samples exist in the evidence; the 0-0.3 deg bin (median 17.7 s) is used for a repeated coordinate
